summary: LitellmModel cannot be used directly in OpenAI Agents SDK on Temporal because the framework requires model names to be strings. Users must create a custom ModelProvider to route between OpenAI and LiteLLM models at the worker level.
userImpact: Users cannot directly use LitellmModel with OpenAI Agents SDK on Temporal without implementing a custom ModelProvider.
rootCause: Temporal workflows serialize agent models and require model names to be strings; LitellmModel object cannot be serialized directly.
proposedFix: Implement a custom RoutingModelProvider that detects model name patterns and routes to appropriate providers (OpenAI or LiteLLM).
workaround: Create a custom ModelProvider class that routes between OpenAIProvider and LitellmProvider based on model name patterns (e.g., "gemini/gemini-3-flash-preview").
resolutionDetails: Issue resolved through documentation and community example. Custom RoutingModelProvider pattern documented as a solution, with suggestion to add example to samples repository.
keyQuote: The more robust way to do it would be to serialize the actual models in their entirety, but that is large and unlikely to be serializable.
